sql.label: Records carrying each field, per institution
sql.sql:
WITH present AS (
  SELECT org, pod_record_id,
         max(field_tag = '020')                AS isbn,
         max(field_tag LIKE '6%')              AS subjects,
         max(field_tag IN ('100','110','111')) AS author,
         max(field_tag = '856')                AS online,
         max(field_tag = '300')                AS phys_desc,
         max(((field_tag = '050' AND subfield_code = 'a') OR (field_tag = '090' AND subfield_code = 'a') OR (field_tag = '852' AND subfield_code = 'h') OR (field_tag = '950' AND subfield_code = 'a') OR (field_tag = '900' AND subfield_code = 'f') OR (field_tag = '099' AND subfield_code = 'a') OR (field_tag = '949' AND subfield_code = 'a')) AND regexp_matches(upper(substr(trim(value), 1, 1)), '[A-Z]')) AS lc_classification
  FROM records
  GROUP BY org, pod_record_id
)
SELECT org, count(*) AS records,
       sum(isbn) AS isbn, sum(subjects) AS subjects, sum(author) AS author,
       sum(online) AS online, sum(phys_desc) AS phys_desc,
       sum(lc_classification) AS lc_classification
FROM present
GROUP BY org
ORDER BY org
